thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: Service=rl-inference-gateway severity=critical PD_INC=INC-2026-0923-001. Trigger: 5xx rate > 10% (5m). PagerDuty URL: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-2026-0923-001. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/rl-inference-gateway#pgd-5xx

pd-bot: PagerDuty notification: Primary on-call (devon) paged, escalation timer started (2m).

devon: ack. I'm looking — pulling logs now. ping @anya in case gateway team has context.

anya: seeing a spike in 502s on /v1/generate in prod-west-1, starting at 10:10Z. Repro: curl -i https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate returned 502s from multiple nodes.

mike: I see connection refused to grpc-serve-worker-2 in the gateway logs: 
```
2026-09-23T10:11:02Z ERROR grpc dial failed: connection refused: 10.12.3.45:9521
2026-09-23T10:11:03Z upstream 502 from model-proxy-1
```

devon: rolling KV: checking load balancer health checks. Could be a flapping worker or network partition. Will try a controlled restart of the worker pool. Tagging customers with active sessions.

sara: putting a short status update on /status and support channel: "Investigating increased 5xx rates on inference gateway, mitigation in progress."

pd-bot: PagerDuty update: Primary (devon) acknowledged at 10:12Z. Secondary (mike) did not acknowledge within window. Escalation to manager (kevin) in 0m.

kevin: acking via PD, joining. What is the customer impact right now?

devon: error ratio peaked at ~18% across prod-west-1, a handful of high-traffic customers hit timeouts. No full region outage. Estimated affected requests ~3k/min for 5m window.

anya: I've started a rolling restart of model-proxy deployment with maxUnavailable=1 to avoid mass disruption. Command: 
```
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/model-proxy --timeout=5m
```

mike: adding logs from the LB: 
```
10.22.11.5 - - [23/Sep/2026:10:11:30 +0000] "POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1" 502 212 "-" "rl-client/1.4"
```

devon: restarting grpc-serve-worker-2 now. Will monitor error rate.

(5 minutes pass)

anya: quick update: after restarting model-proxy pods one by one, 5xx rate dropped to ~2.1% and latency returned to baseline within 4 minutes. Still keeping watch for recurrence.

pd-bot: PagerDuty: Escalation policy fired: Manager (kevin) notified because secondary missed ack. Incident assigned to kevin in PD.

kevin: thanks team. Good quick work. Can someone confirm whether this was a single worker crash or a networking blip?

mike: initial hypothesis: a noisy GC caused grpc listener to be unresponsive, peer connections timed out which bubbled up as 502s. Attaching GC logs for the worker: 
```
[gc] 2026-09-23T10:09:58 Pause for 1200ms
[gc] 2026-09-23T10:10:01 Heap pressure spike
```

devon: that matches the timeline. Suggest we add a liveness/readiness tweak and increase cpu request on the heavy-traffic workers. Will open a follow-up PR after incident.

kevin: agree. For now, capture timeline and impact. @sara please escalate to account execs for the 3 customers I listed earlier.

sara: done — support ticket created and AE notified. Ticket #SUP-5567.

oncall-rotation: note: devon -> mike handoff at 10:20Z (devon shift out). Handoff message: "gateway 5xx spike mitigated by rolling restart; root cause likely GC impacting grpc worker; follow-up PR to bump resource requests and add health-check tolerance."

devon: handing off to mike. I've left the restart command and log links in the incident timeline. If it flares, escalate to kevin immediately (PD escalation policy).

mike: ack, will monitor next 30m. Adding temporary alert suppression for noisy worker restarts to avoid duplicate PD pages while we stabilize.

pd-bot: PagerDuty: Incident INC-2026-0923-001 acknowledged by kevin at 10:18Z. (Auto-close disabled until triage complete.)

anya: adding mitigation note: error rate back to 0.9% at 10:16Z, no further customer reports.

kevin: closing the page for now. Formal postmortem required. Action items: (1) PR to bump CPU request for model-proxy & grpc workers, (2) add GC monitoring alert threshold, (3) update runbook with step to check GC pauses and to throttle rollout. Owner assignments: devon (PR), anya (alert), mike (runbook update). Due EOD+2.

devon: noted. I'll open the PR today and include perf numbers from the restart.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0923-001 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Closing PD incident in 24h if no regression.

kevin: thanks everyone. I'll add this to the weekly oncall review.

mike: closing thread here, re-open if we see any recurrence. :thumbsup:

(reacted :eyes: by kevin, :white_check_mark: by devon)
